summary: Las Vegas Sands Corp. completed an underwritten public offering of $500M 5.300% Senior Notes due 2031 and $500M 5.650% Senior Notes due 2033. Net proceeds, with cash on hand, will redeem the $1.0B 3.500% Senior Notes due August 2026, pay fees, and for general corporate purposes. The unsecured notes are senior obligations with no subsidiary guarantees, issued under a 2019 indenture supplemented by tenth and eleventh supplemental indentures. Interest is semi-annual; redemption prior to par call dates is at present value. Watch for the August 2026 note redemption execution and potential impact on leverage ratios.
